workpackages.title: Target-relative completion epistemics and obligation model
acceptance: host-affecting work is represented as TargetObligation objects rather than artifact-presence checklists
missing mandatory evidence evaluates UNKNOWN not PASS
every mandatory obligation has independent positive readback and counterevidence probe
overall host completion cannot be COMPLETE while a mandatory obligation is UNKNOWN
completion outcome is explicitly scoped by fidelity level

workpackages.title: Read-only target host fingerprint collector and versioned profile
acceptance: collector records non-secret hardware/firmware/OS/session/multimedia/browser/service topology
collector does not collect credentials, clipboard, raw camera frames, raw microphone audio or user documents
profile contains exact generation and digest
unknown fields remain explicit UNKNOWN rather than inferred defaults
material target changes create a new profile generation

workpackages.title: Ubuntu target userspace twin bootstrap
acceptance: twin can reproduce observed target distro/kernel/package/session shape within documented limits
systemd system and user-manager behavior is exercised
target-like UID/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/session-DBus topology is exercised
installer is executed through the same one-handoff path intended for physical delivery
twin records where it differs from the target profile instead of masking the delta

workpackages.title: Desktop session and multimedia topology twin
acceptance: PipeWire/WirePlumber lifecycle and device topology are represented
xdg-desktop-portal/session-DBus permission boundary is represented
Wayland/X11/session-context mismatch is testable
audio source/sink and camera/display/browser synthetic endpoints support generation changes
service-active-but-unusable paths have explicit falsifiers

workpackages.title: Target host fault scenario engine
acceptance: fault engine injects permission deny/revoke/stale generations
fault engine injects device absent/late/remove/re-add/default-route change/EBUSY
fault engine injects PipeWire/WirePlumber/portal/user-manager restart
fault engine injects network latency/loss/reset/DNS/bridge reconnect and clock skew
fault engine injects filesystem ownership/read-only/low-space/package-lock/partial-install faults
fault engine injects process kill/reboot/logout-login/suspend-resume-equivalent epoch changes
fault engine records an exact deterministic scenario timeline and seed

workpackages.title: Target trace capture and replay calibration
acceptance: sanitized target event traces can parameterize the twin without carrying user content
device IDs/generations, service ordering, D-Bus owner changes and multimedia topology changes are replayable
replay reports non-reproducible physical-only events as fidelity gaps
trace replay never grants T4 physical credit

workpackages.title: Independent negative-space completion verifier
acceptance: verifier compares desired target obligations against observed target state rather than installer claims
verifier enumerates absent/stale/wrong-owner/wrong-user/wrong-session/unproven obligations
verifier executes counterevidence probes
implementation path cannot self-authorize completion
TargetCompletionReport lists all UNKNOWN and physical-only obligations

workpackages.title: Portable release install/update/rollback under hostile target twin
acceptance: exact release candidate ZIP is installed into a fresh twin
partial prior install, wrong permissions and stale cache copies are exercised
update/rollback preserve one durable state lineage
logout/login/reboot/restart readback passes at twin scope
host-switch and optional VPS bridge attach/detach do not duplicate canonical state

workpackages.title: Sustained heterogeneous host chaos acceptance matrix
acceptance: matrix combines concurrent multimedia, permission, lifecycle, network and resource-pressure faults
no unbounded queue/state/provenance growth under sustained faults
perception/voice degrade before cognition/state corruption
stale device/permission/session authority cannot revive after recovery
completion verifier refuses premature success throughout the run

workpackages.title: Physical target correlation and twin-gap ledger
acceptance: first physical target acceptance compares observed failures with twin predictions
every physical-only surprise is recorded as a new twin fault or explicit non-emulatable gap
known twin blind spots remain visible in release reporting
no physical issue is retroactively marked simulated without exact evidence
subsequent release candidates replay previously observed target failures

final_gate.name: TARGET_HOST_REALITY_TWIN_HANDOFF_GATE
final_gate.rule: A release candidate may be READY_FOR_PHYSICAL_ACCEPTANCE only after all non-physical mandatory target obligations have passed at their declared T0-T3 fidelity and all remaining T4-only obligations are explicitly listed. Final Frankenstein 2.0 completion still requires T4 physical acceptance.
